title: Anuradha Bhasin v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Anuradha Bhasin v. Union of India, (2020) 3 SCC 637
content.holding: Freedom of speech and trade over the internet is protected under Article 19(1)(a) and 19(1)(g); indefinite internet shutdowns are illegal.
content.relevance: Applies proportionality test to internet shutdowns and communication restrictions.
